title: Dayum Bird
description: The 'Dayum' bird has arrived! Encounter this iconic, high-tech creature in the wild—but be careful, it guards rare treasures and doesn't take kindly to being hit.
body:

## **Dayum Bird**

Ever seen a bird that looks a little... familiar? Meet the DayumBird, a mechanical marvel inspired by the legendary "Dayum bird" meme. But don't let its looks fool you; this isn't just a feathered friend—it’s a high-stakes encounter!

### Features

**The Look:** A custom-modeled entity that brings a touch of humor (and a lot of mechanical style) to your world.

**Neutral but Lethal:** The DayumBird is perfectly happy to leave you alone... until you start trouble. If provoked, it becomes extremely aggressive and is surprisingly dangerous. You’ve been warned!

**A Rare Treasure:** Why would anyone fight such a bird? Because it holds something immensely valuable.

**New Crafting Materials:** Defeating (or taming!) these birds yields a unique item that serves as a core component for high-tier crafting recipes.

**Where to Find Them Keep your eyes on the skies! They primarily spawn in:**

- Swamps
